versions.changelog:
Case Study Generator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a skill that transforms customer success stories into full, publication-ready B2B case studies.
- Covers all expected sections: customer narrative, results with metrics (incl. ROI tables), compelling pull quotes, and four deliverable formats (blog, one-pager, LinkedIn post, email snippet).
- Provides detailed, structured prompts tailored for SaaS teams, agencies, consultants, and freelancers.
- Includes usage guide, input requirements, comprehensive example, pricing strategy, and revenue projection for varied business models.
